## Reflection

The Aurora kinase inhibitor call was correct because the core phenotype replicated across five independent wells from 0.01 to 3 uM: frac_large_nucleus z +59 to +107, nuc_form_factor z -38 to -44, nuc_area z +24 to +29 with increased integrated DNA, preserved tubulin by eye and by flat tub_mean dose-response, and atlas 9/10 Aurora neighbors. The main misleading signals were the 30 uM well and the dose-response slope. At 30 uM, describe_phenotype reported lower density with rounding and suggested actin disruptors/microtubule destabilizers, and acquire_well showed cell_roundness and cell_solidity z ~+37; the frac_large_nucleus dose-response was strongly negative (rho -0.94) because the effect was already saturated at the lowest 0.01 uM dose.
